title: A delivered item's page and row show the merge gate passed and no proof gap
description: Against the head served by e2e-serve, drive one fixture item through the real merge writer's flight — claim, submit, an independent review, the trial that executes its proofs, the push and its reconciliation — with proofs no principal in that plane is authorized to produce. The delivered work row and the item page then show the merge gate passed with the pushed sha, no pending gate and no proof gap, instead of the merge writer's stale push refusal.
